# Pure Photo N.I

> Award winning husband and wife wedding photography team based in Lisburn, Northern Ireland. Tommy and Laurene have photographed weddings and elopements together since 2014, working in a documentary first style with relaxed creative portraits.

Pure Photo N.I covers weddings and elopements across the whole of Northern Ireland, including Belfast, Lisburn, Co. Antrim, Co. Down, Co. Armagh, Co. Londonderry, Co. Tyrone and Co. Fermanagh, and also travels for weddings in the Republic of Ireland and further afield.

Every wedding is photographed by both Tommy and Laurene, so couples always get two photographers with one shared approach. The style is natural and unposed, built around the moments nobody planned, with relaxed couple portraits rather than long shot lists.

Contact: info@purephotoni.com, 07936 576837, 36 Johnston Way, Lisburn, Co. Antrim, BT28 2AQ. Open Monday to Saturday 9am to 9pm and Sunday 1pm to 5pm.

## Awards and recognition

- Named Best Wedding Photography Team at the Northern Irish Enterprise Awards 2025.
- Nominated for and awarded multiple wedding photography awards over more than a decade of shooting.
- On the recommended and preferred photographer lists at Larchfield Estate, Breckenhill, The Old Court Wedding Company, Dufferin Hall and La Mon Hotel.
- Featured by BBC Radio Ulster, the Belfast Telegraph, the Northern Ireland Wedding Journal, Local Women Magazine, the Ulster Star and Guides for Brides.
- Members of the Society of Wedding and Portrait Photographers (SWPP) and an official Bridebook wedding photographer.
- Photographing weddings across Northern Ireland together since 2014, with hundreds of weddings covered as a team.
- Two photographers on every wedding as standard, not as a paid add on.
- Consistently five star reviewed by couples across Belfast and Northern Ireland.
